description: This source file implements certain interface functions for an HTTP server component called Http Simple Server Object, specifically for handling WSP (Web Service Protocol) accept and serve operations. The functions provided are stubs that currently return default values indicating acceptance and success respectively, and do not contain business logic.

methods.name: BOOL HttpSsoWspAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hClientInfo)
methods.description: Function to determine if the server accepts a particular client connection; currently always returns TRUE.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpSsoWspServe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hWebsSession,ANSC_HANDLE hWebsTrans,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage)
methods.description: Function to handle serving a web session/transaction/message; currently always returns success.
